metadata.description: Mainmind: your agents and your space's knowledge, synced in every AI app. A space can hold a company, a job hunt or anything else.

plugins.name: mainmind
plugins.description: Your agents and your space's knowledge, synced in every app. Continue with any agent where you left off, ask what your space knows, and put a decision to its owner as one question. You sign in as yourself, and the plugin holds no passwords or keys.
